rows.note: Use this medical term for the process of starting labour artificially.

example.english: The doctor recommended that I be admitted next week for induction to ensure the safety of the mother and baby.
example.traditional: 醫生建議我下星期入院引產，確保母嬰安全。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 gin3 ji5 ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jap6 jyun2 jan5 caan2 kok3 bou2 mou5 jing1 on1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for welcoming and orienting newcomers at a workplace or school.

example.english: The company will hold an induction for new colleagues next week to introduce the work procedures and office rules.
example.traditional: 公司下星期會為新同事舉辦迎新，介紹工作流程同辦公室規矩。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 wai6 san1 tung4 si6 geoi2 baan6 jing4 san1 gaai3 siu6 gung1 zok3 lau4 cing4 tung4 baan6 gung1 sat1 kwai1 geoi2

rows.note: Use this for the formal ceremony appointing someone to an office, rather than for military induction.

example.english: The school held an induction ceremony in the hall for the new principal to formally welcome them into office.
example.traditional: 學校喺禮堂為新任校長舉行就職典禮，正式歡迎佢上任。
